content_metadata.description: This video presents an interactive game where the user learns about different human body systems by dragging and dropping organs to their correct locations.

qAndA.question: Which organ is described as "the hip bone"?

qAndA.answer: It automatically moves to its correct position on the human body outline.
qAndA.question: What happens when the user double-clicks on an organ?

qAndA.answer: A message appears stating, "Oops, that organ doesn't belong in this system!"
qAndA.question: How does the game indicate that an organ has been placed incorrectly?

qAndA.answer: Dragging and dropping organs, and clicking on buttons.
qAndA.question: What are the two main actions the user performs in the game?

qAndA.answer: Curious and educational. The interactive gameplay and focus on learning create an engaging and informative atmosphere.

activities.description: User drags and drops pelvis onto the human body outline
User double-clicks organs to place them
User completes skeletal system and clicks "Ok"
User starts placing digestive system organs
User completes digestive system and clicks "Ok"
User starts placing respiratory system organs
